summary_1line: Vyasa critiques doctrines of blind naturalism, praises wisdom and knowledge, outlines hierarchy of beings, and elevates Brahman-knowers who transcend birth and death.

image_candidates.scene_text: A serene sage sits teaching disciples beneath a forest tree while students listen as he speaks of the Self within and beyond all beings.
A radiant knower of Brahman stands calmly as the entire cosmos—creatures, plants, and stars—appears to rest within and around him.
Scholars and ascetics debate the causes of action—Time, Nature, Exertion—while a silent yogin meditates apart, contemplating Brahman as the true cause.
